name: regression-credit-inverted-ownership
description: Captured pattern where every AI candidate is a misclassification - including a credit user_retains_content_ownership whose quote actually says the service is the sole owner. The verifier must reject all of them. All operator names are synthetic placeholders per the legal-posture testing rule.
